service_state_context.reason: ServiceState bandwidth vectors are current-service context, but their nested CellIdentity lacks an exact unmasked CI/PCI matching the candidate B7 snapshots. Channel and subscription alone do not disambiguate two same-channel candidate identities, and cell snapshots report connection_status=NONE.

source_reference: Android CellIdentityLte.getBandwidth returns a value in kHz or UNAVAILABLE; Android ServiceState.getCellBandwidths describes currently camped cells. See Android CellIdentityLte and ServiceState APIs.
